# Anthony Dake

> Drummer and producer based in Columbus, Ohio. Live shows, tours and fly dates, remote and in-room session drums, drum programming and production. ~405 documented performances and ~52 record credits since 2017.

## What I do

- **Drummer** — live shows, tours, and fly dates; session drums remote or in your room. Click, IEM, acoustic and hybrid rigs.
- **Producer** — drum programming and production for records. Remote, fast, release-ready stems.

## Background

- Drum Corps International tours with Blue Knights (2017, 2018, World Class)
- Winter Guard International with Rhythm X (2020, Independent World) and Dojo Percussion
- DCI Open Class with Shadow Drum & Bugle Corps
- Marching band, jazz ensemble, percussion ensemble through high school and college
- 5+ years of weekly church drumming growing up
